comparison.objective: Candidate performs temporary lifting and fixture loading; record sharpens a knife on a whetstone and leaves it safely oriented.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires insertion, locking, shackle manipulation, suspended-load seating, and extraction; record requires repeated edge-leading strokes with controlled blade angle and coverage on both faces.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retention, lift, three-pad support, and safe withdrawal; record grades measured edge sharpness or stroke/coverage proxies plus safe released placement.
comparison.reason: The physical interactions and functional outcomes are unrelated; all thirteen sharpening rubric versions were available and sufficiently detailed.
